in_marathi.name: राहुल
in_marathi.long_meaning: राहुल हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। राहुल is a Sanskrit name derived from the word राहु, which means 'sun'. In Hindu mythology, Rahu is a demon who is the head of a serpent that swallows the sun during a solar eclipse. The name राहुल is considered auspicious and is given to boys to bless them with the strength and power of the sun.
